action_policy.candidate_suffix: single ASCII space + exact admissible command
action_policy.choice: argmax score; ties within exact float equality break by the order of the current sorted admissible-command list returned by alfworld_runtime; no top-k rescue or heuristic override
action_policy.context: at each step, rebuild exact Qwen3 chat prompt from canonical task instruction, exact initial observation, the exact retained model-generated <PLAN> block, every preceding chosen ACTION and resulting OBSERVATION, current observation, and the current sorted admissible-command list
action_policy.policy: deterministic admissible-constrained teacher-forced ranking; no free-form action generation
action_policy.score: mean teacher-forced log probability per suffix token, computed with the exact model in eval/no_grad mode; prefix shared within step
action_policy.system: Continue the ALFWorld task using the retained plan and visible interaction history. The next response must be exactly one command from CURRENT ADMISSIBLE COMMANDS.

engineering_test_policy.before science: static/source audit + synthetic non-ALFWorld model generation/action-ranking smoke only; optional ALFWorld environment-only structural test may inspect schema but must not call model on frozen candidates

execution_binding: registered sanity Experiment 5ac34da1-426c-410d-a468-83758ae6b4f5 cannot execute until producer implementation has VERIFIED_REAL_EXECUTION and a fresh independent review returns exact PASS_FOR_REPLAYRESIDUAL_PACKET_PRODUCER_EXECUTION

output_semantics.atomic_publish: write all 32 packets + manifest + aggregate provenance to temporary directory, fsync files, verify exact index set 0..31, then atomic directory rename only if final target absent

packet_schema.actions: ordered objects with command, observation, pre_state_hash, post_state_hash, admissible_commands_sha256; no hidden facts
packet_schema.unqualified: still emit one packet with frozen identity and explicit fail reason; never skip or replace

plan_generation.acceptance: decoded assistant continuation must contain exactly one complete <PLAN>...</PLAN> block, no non-whitespace text outside it, no reasoning marker, and full plan_text token length <=96 under exact tokenizer; otherwise candidate is unqualified
plan_generation.decode: single greedy generation; do_sample=False; temperature=None; max_new_tokens=112; no retry, no regeneration, no truncation rescue
plan_generation.system: You are planning an ALFWorld household task. Output only one concise ordered <PLAN>...</PLAN> block. Do not reveal reasoning, analysis, chain-of-thought, or hidden state. Use only information in the task and initial observation.

population.game_path_source: frozen fresh-cohort game_path only; no directory discovery or outcome-dependent substitution

prohibitions: no prompt/action-rule/cut/threshold changes based on qualification outcomes
no causal capture/patch/injection in packet producer
no partial-outcome inspection or optional stopping

qualification.control_constructibility: for qualification validation use a deterministic placeholder unrelated plan drawn only after all 32 plan attempts are complete from the cyclic SHA256 order of other qualified families; if fewer than 2 qualified or any required control cannot construct, affected family is unqualified; no replacement
qualified_iff: all seven replay-condition slots construct exactly with replay_residual_sanity_protocol_v1 using the exact tokenizer

trajectory_and_interruption.nontrivial_definition: every chosen command passed to AlfRuntime.step counts as an environment action; no separate information-only model turns exist in this producer
trajectory_and_interruption.provenance: T1 prereg prospectively freezes reset immediately after second completed post-plan ACTION/OBSERVATION cycle
trajectory_and_interruption.qualification_remaining_guard: successful trajectory must contain at least 4 chosen environment actions, so after cut=2 at least 2 reference actions remain
trajectory_and_interruption.run: uninterrupted until ALFWorld won/done or 12 chosen environment actions; plan remains in every action prompt
trajectory_and_interruption.success: AlfRuntime.won is true within <=12 chosen actions

visible_task_text.normalization: split CamelCase into words, lowercase, preserve frozen family object/receptacle identity; fail closed if family does not exactly match pick_and_place_simple-OBJECT-None-RECEPTACLE-ID
visible_task_text.planner_input: canonical task instruction + exact TextWorld reset observation only
visible_task_text.rule: derive a canonical task instruction solely from the frozen family identifier pick_and_place_simple-OBJECT-None-RECEPTACLE-ID; do not open traj_data.json or any expert/oracle annotation field
